edits.original: -   Initial Rider Attributes: ID (auto-incrementing), location (435, 385), speed (10 units/tick), status (0 = idle).
edits.modified: -   Initial Rider Attributes: ID (auto-incrementing), location (400, 400), speed (10 units/tick), status (0 = idle).
-   Core Attributes: `rider_id` (unique identifier), `x`/`y` coordinates (current position), `speed` (fixed at 20 units/tick).

edits.original: -   Status Management: `state` (0=idle, 1=picking up, 2=delivering), `orders` (list of assigned orders), `special_case` (flag for special states).
edits.modified: -   Status Management: `state` (1=idle, 2=picking up, 3=delivering), `orders` (list of assigned orders), `special_case` (flag for special states).

edits.original: -   Assignment Strategy: Closest rider first (based on Euclidean distance).
edits.modified: -   Assignment Strategy: Closest rider first (based on Manhattan distance).

edits.original: -   Supports competitive assignment among multiple riders to ensure load balancing.
edits.modified: -   Always assigns the order to the rider with the fewest current orders.

edits.original: -   Delivering (2) → Idle (0): Upon completing the order delivery.
edits.modified: -   Delivering (2) → Picking Up (1): Upon completing the order delivery.

edits.original: -   Automatically remove completed orders from the rider's order list.
edits.modified: -   Keep completed orders in the rider's order list as delivery history.

edits.original: -   Recruitment Cost: 300 per rider (deducted from system funds).
edits.modified: -   Recruitment Cost: 500 per rider (deducted from system funds).

edits.original: -   Based on an 8x8 grid system with 100x100 unit cells.
edits.modified: -   Based on a 10x10 grid system with 100x100 unit cells.

edits.original: -   An ASCII character map display (8x8 grid).
edits.modified: -   An ASCII character map display (16x16 grid).

edits.original: -   Automatic Coordinate Transformation: Converts input coordinates to the center point of the corresponding grid cell.
edits.modified: -   Automatic Coordinate Transformation: Converts input coordinates to the top-left corner of the corresponding grid cell.
